description: Opens a filing in the chat for the user: a card with what it reports, and the filing as filed to read and search, with a quoted passage marked. Call it when the user asks to open, show, see or read a filing ("show me Nvidia's latest 8-K") or where a quote stands in it. When they ask for one part of it (a statement such as the balance sheet, or an item such as Risk Factors), pass section and it opens there. Get the documentId first from ListFilings, SearchDocuments or SearchDocument. Show at most one card per answer. Never call it to read a filing yourself: ReadDocumentLines and SearchDocument return the text.

citedText.description: The passage's own words, copied from the filing, when you quote it in the answer.

documentId.description: Document id from ListFilings or SearchDocuments.

fromLine.description: First line of the passage to open at, as numbered by ReadDocumentLines and SearchDocument. Omit to open at the top.

section.description: A part of the filing to open at instead of a passage: an item ("Item 7", "Risk Factors") or a heading as the filing words it ("Consolidated Balance Sheets").

toLine.description: Last line of that passage (default: fromLine).

name: ShowFiling
title: Show Filing
